input.platform: Linux AMD64, native shift-native Vulkan plugin

changes.relative_alu_constant: The third DOT2ADD source now uses its captured a0 offset. The prior translation fetched fixed c68 for all ten glyphs and displayed repeated L characters.
changes.gamma_texture_sampling: Captured Gamma texture channels now use the Xenos piecewise gamma-to-linear function after sampling; alpha remains linear. Captured signs outside the unsigned/gamma subset fail closed.
changes.gamma_render_target: Pixel RGB exported to a captured RGBA8_GAMMA target uses Xenos piecewise linear-to-gamma encoding before storage; alpha remains linear.
changes.copy_convert_channels: The renderer already stores the guest target in canonical RGBA channel order. The captured destination R/B flag remains validated, but the presenter no longer applies a second host-side swap in Copy/Convert.
